# Columns (tab-separated): goal (a Lean goal state, abbreviated), useful premises
# (comma-separated lemma names from lemmas.tsv that close or advance the goal).
a b : ℕ ⊢ a + b = b + a
n : ℕ ⊢ n * 1 = n
a b c : ℕ ⊢ a * (b + c) = a * b + a * c
x y z : ℕ h₁ : x ≤ y h₂ : y ≤ z ⊢ x ≤ z
n : ℕ ⊢ Even n ∨ Odd n
m n : ℕ h : Even m ⊢ Even (m * n)
a b c : ℕ h₁ : a ∣ b h₂ : b ∣ c ⊢ a ∣ c
d a b : ℕ ha : d ∣ a hb : d ∣ b ⊢ d ∣ a + b
a b : ℕ ⊢ Nat.gcd a b = Nat.gcd b a
p a b : ℕ hp : p.Prime h : p ∣ a * b ⊢ p ∣ a ∨ p ∣ b
p : ℕ hp : p.Prime ⊢ 0 < p
N : ℕ ⊢ ∃ p, N ≤ p ∧ p.Prime
n : ℕ ⊢ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), i = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, i + n
s t : Finset α f : α → β hc : t.card < s.card hf : ∀ a ∈ s, f a ∈ t ⊢ ∃ x ∈ s, ∃ y ∈ s, x ≠ y ∧ f x = f y
a b c d n : ℤ h₁ : a ≡ b [ZMOD n] h₂ : c ≡ d [ZMOD n] ⊢ a * c ≡ b * d [ZMOD n]
a b n : ℤ k : ℕ h : a ≡ b [ZMOD n] ⊢ a ^ k ≡ b ^ k [ZMOD n]
p : ℕ hp : p.Prime a : ZMod p ha : a ≠ 0 ⊢ a ^ (p - 1) = 1
G : Type [Group G] a b : G ⊢ (a * b)⁻¹ = b⁻¹ * a⁻¹
G : Type [Group G] a : G ⊢ a * a⁻¹ = 1
G : Type [Group G] [Fintype G] x : G ⊢ x ^ Fintype.card G = 1
M : Type [Monoid M] a : M m n : ℕ ⊢ a ^ (m + n) = a ^ m * a ^ n
ε : ℝ hε : 0 < ε ⊢ 0 < ε / 2
x : ℝ hx : 0 ≤ x ⊢ √x ^ 2 = x
x : ℝ ⊢ x + 1 ≤ Real.exp x
x y : ℝ hx : 0 < x hy : 0 < y ⊢ Real.log (x * y) = Real.log x + Real.log y
x : ℝ ⊢ Real.sin x ^ 2 + Real.cos x ^ 2 = 1
x y z : α [MetricSpace α] ⊢ dist x z ≤ dist x y + dist y z
u : ℕ → ℝ ⊢ Filter.Tendsto u Filter.atTop (nhds a) ↔ ∀ ε > 0, ∃ N, ∀ n ≥ N, dist (u n) a < ε
f g : ℕ → ℝ hf : Filter.Tendsto f Filter.atTop (nhds a) hg : Filter.Tendsto g Filter.atTop (nhds b) ⊢ Filter.Tendsto (fun n => f n + g n) Filter.atTop (nhds (a + b))
f g : ℝ → ℝ hf : Continuous f hg : Continuous g ⊢ Continuous (g ∘ f)
f : ℝ → ℝ a b : ℝ hab : a < b hfc : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b) hfd : DifferentiableOn ℝ f (Set.Ioo a b) ⊢ ∃ c ∈ Set.Ioo a b, deriv f c = (f b - f a) / (b - a)
s t : Set α ⊢ (s ∪ t)ᶜ = sᶜ ∩ tᶜ
s t : Set α h₁ : s ⊆ t h₂ : t ⊆ s ⊢ s = t
f : β → γ g : α → β hf : Function.Injective f hg : Function.Injective g ⊢ Function.Injective (f ∘ g)
l : List α ⊢ l.reverse.reverse = l
l₁ l₂ : List α ⊢ (l₁ ++ l₂).length = l₁.length + l₂.length
A B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ ⊢ (A * B).det = A.det * B.det
